Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 34 (CoreSite missing-address campaign): added an operator-confirmed address and square footage, an aggregator up-to design MW figure recorded in capacity_note only. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CoreSite was founded in 2001 as CRG West, a Carlyle Group portfolio company, beginning operations at two West Coast carrier hotel buildings, Market Post Tower and One Wilshire, both in Los Angeles. The firm rebranded from CRG West to CoreSite in June 2009 and completed an IPO in September 2010. American Tower Corporation, the public tower and infrastructure company (NYSE: AMT, SEC CIK 1053507), completed its acquisition of CoreSite in December 2021. Stonepeak Partners LP later bought roughly 29 percent of American Towers US data center business directly in July 2022, increasing that stake to about 36 percent by October 2022. CoreSites own current Silicon Valley regional page (operator source, tier-1, https://www.coresite.com/data-center-locations/silicon-valley) names nine data centers on this Santa Clara campus, SV1 through SV9, totaling more than 1.4 million square feet campus wide, but only describes SV1, SV2, SV4, SV7, SV8, and SV9 individually, SV1 and SV2 are not rows in this registry. SV3, SV5, and SV6 are not detailed on that page, so their building specific facts below come from data center industry aggregator directories instead. CoreSites own regional page gives this specific building, SV7, an address of 3020 Coronado Drive, Santa Clara, CA 95054, with 227,000 plus square feet, corroborated by Baxtel and DataCenterMap. Baxtel additionally describes this building as supporting up to 18 MW of critical IT load, a maximum design figure from an aggregator rather than a confirmed current operating figure published by the operator, so it is recorded in capacity_note only and not applied to critical_it_mw, consistent with this projects treatment of up-to and design-maximum figures elsewhere.
